items.html: *And the matter, in explanation: know that in the months of the Ibur, from the seven kings there were clarified, for ZON, little by little, degree after degree, over the course of the time of the months of the Ibur, both in the aspect of the vessels and in the aspect of the lights and sparks, as explained at length in the preceding part. And the clarification began from the aspect of the Keter of ZA that is in the seven kings. And there remained Hod, Yesod, and Malchut, of which some was clarified, but not all the parts that are in them, which are from the aspect of ZA of the world of Atzilut; for it is necessary that when ZA is born, he comes out complete, in 248 limbs and in ten Sefirot.
